bots.nuevoRuta.texto: Give the bot in the dialog a name and create it: the editor then opens with that DNA.
bots.ficha.ayuda: Open this tab in the manual
bots.mismoAdnAyuda: Some forum files share the same DNA: they share favorite, tags and notes, and are picked together.
bots.sel.favAyuda: Mark the picked bots as favorites
bots.sel.tagAgregar: Add the tag to the picked bots
bots.sel.tagQuitar: Remove the tag from the picked bots
bots.seleccion.ayuda: Saves the {n} picked bots under a name, to pick them again with one click.
bots.seleccion.cargar: Pick the bots of this selection
bots.lote.actualAyuda: They are added to the running world; each species is recorded as an event of the run.
bots.lote.sinCorrida: No run is open: start one in Observe to seed into it.
bots.lote.nuevoAyuda: Creates a scenario of your own with these species in the default world and opens it in Experiment.
bots.lote.sembradas: Seeded {n} species into the current run.
bots.lote.sinAdn: Could not read the DNA of {nombre}: it was not seeded.
bots.lote.mucho: More than {n} bots per species is a lot: the simulation may run slowly. They are seeded anyway.
bots.lote.renombrado: “{de}” was repeated in the batch: the species is named “{a}”.
bots.selector.buscar: Search by name, file, tag or note
bots.selector.algunos: Showing {n} of {total}: type to narrow down.
bots.almacen.bloqueado: Another tab with an older version of the app is blocking your data: close or reload it. Meanwhile only the forum bots are shown.
bots.almacen.fallo: Could not read your bots and marks ({detalle}). Only the forum bots are shown.
bots.foro.fallo: Could not read the list of forum bots ({detalle}). Only your bots are shown.
bots.migracion.enCurso: Importing the data from the classic interface…
bots.datos.adnAyuda: Paste a DNA or start with the empty gene and edit it in the DNA tab.
bots.duplicar.ayuda: Empty: the same name with a number. The copy is yours and can be edited; the source bot does not change.
bots.confirmar.nombreForo: “{nombre}” is the name of a forum bot. If you use it, scenarios and runs will tell them apart only by their source. Use it anyway?
bots.confirmar.borrarBot: Delete “{nombre}” with all its versions? This cannot be undone.
bots.confirmar.borrarSeleccion: Delete the selection “{nombre}”? The bots are not touched.
bots.confirmar.pisarSeleccion: There is already a selection “{nombre}”. Replace it with the picked bots?
bots.confirmar.restaurar: Go back to version {n}? It is saved as a new version: none is lost.
bots.aviso.duplicado: Copy “{nombre}” created: it can be edited now.
bots.ficha.noEncontrado: There is no bot “{clave}” in the library.
bots.inicio.texto: Pick a bot from the library to see its summary, its DNA and where it took part. Tick several to seed them together or save them as a selection.
bots.resumen.sinDescripcion: No description: the DNA does not start with comments.
bots.resumen.adnFallo: Could not read the DNA of this bot.
bots.resumen.capsAyuda: Profile computed by analyzing the DNA, gene by gene.
bots.resumen.sinCaps: This bot has no capability profile.
bots.resumen.sinCapsPropio: Your own bots have no capability profile: see what they read and write.
bots.resumen.notasAyuda: Free notes (saved when you leave the field)
bots.versiones.ayuda: Every time the DNA is saved a version is kept; going back to an older one adds it as a new one.
bots.historial.sinCorridas: It does not appear in any saved run.
bots.historial.sinTorneos: It took part in no tournament.
bots.historial.sinPruebas: It has not been tested yet.
bots.historial.ayuda: The history is built from your data in this browser, recognizing the bot by its DNA hash.
bots.migracion.titulo: Data from the classic interface was imported:
bots.migracion.nada: The classic interface has no library data in this browser.
bots.migracion.vacia: There was nothing new to import.
bots.migracion.marcas: {n} bots with marks ({favoritos} favorites, {tags} with tags, {notas} with notes).
bots.migracion.huerfanas: {n} of those marks belong to bots no longer in the forum (kept anyway).
bots.migracion.seleccionesOmitidas: {n} selections already existed with the same name and were left alone.
bots.migracion.hibridos: {n} lab hybrids, now bots of your own.
bots.migracion.renombrados: {n} bots got another name because theirs was taken.
bots.migracion.incompleto: The hybrid “{nombre}” is missing {n} genes that no longer exist.
bots.migracion.sinGenes: The hybrid “{nombre}” could not be built: the gene data is missing.
bots.migracion.vacio: The hybrid “{nombre}” has no genes and was not imported.
bots.migracion.invalidos: {n} records could not be read and were skipped.
bots.importar.formatoClasica: Inventory exported from the classic interface.
bots.importar.actualizados: {n} bots of your own updated with new versions.
bots.importar.yaEstaban: {n} bots of your own were already here.
bots.importar.renombrados: {n} bots got another name because theirs was taken.
bots.importar.notasPisadas: {n} notes were replaced by the ones in the file.
bots.importar.seleccionesPisadas: {n} selections replaced others with the same name.
bots.importar.conflicto: “{nombre}” changed differently here and in the file: the file's one was kept as “{nuevo}”.
bots.importar.invalidos: {n} records could not be read and were skipped.
bots.error.nombre-repetido: You already have a bot called “{nombre}”.
bots.error.nombre-del-foro: “{nombre}” is the name of a forum bot.
bots.error.no-existe: That bot is no longer in the library.
bots.error.no-es-propio: Forum bots are read-only: duplicate it to edit it.
bots.error.json-invalido: The file is not valid JSON.
bots.error.formato-desconocido: The file is neither a bot library nor an exported inventory.
bots.error.version-nueva: The file comes from a newer version ({version}): reload the page.
bots.error.lectura: The data of the classic interface could not be read.
bots.error.cuota: There is no storage space left in this browser.
bots.error.almacen.version-vieja: Another tab opened a newer version of the app: reload this page.
bots.error.almacen.sin-indexeddb: This browser does not allow saving data (IndexedDB).
bots.inscribir.ayuda: Enters this bot, with its current DNA, in the quick match or in a tournament.
bots.inscribir.vegetal: Vegetables do not fight in tournaments.
bots.inscribir.congelado: The DNA is frozen when entered: later changes to the bot do not reach this season.
bots.inscribir.fallo: Could not open “{torneo}” to enter the bot.
bots.inscribir.falloDetalle: Could not open “{torneo}” to enter the bot: {detalle}
bots.inscribir.abre: Entering it opens that tournament in Compete (it becomes the open tournament).
bots.inscribir.noAbre: A tournament is in progress: the bot is entered without opening the chosen tournament, and the one in progress isn't offered.
bots.inscribir.ninguno: There's no other tournament to enter it in: the one in progress can't be edited while it plays.
